story.text: Along came a {WOLF}. “Little pig, little pig, let me come in!” “No, no, not by the hair of my chinny chin {CHIN}!” “Then I’ll {HUFF}, and I’ll {PUFF}, and I’ll {BLOW} your house in!” And he did. The little pig ran to his brother’s house of sticks, but the wolf blew that down too.
story.caption: Then I’ll huff and I’ll puff
